videos.subject: Why losing money hurts twice as much 💸
videos.script: A loss hurts about twice as much as the same win feels good. Flip a coin: lose a hundred dollars, or win a hundred and fifty. Many people say no. Across a hundred and fifty studies, the win had to be about twice the loss. Your brain guards what you have more than what you could get. That's why
